findings.title: Unpinned GitHub Action (uses tag or branch instead of SHA)
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a full 40-character commit SHA instead of a tag or branch reference, e.g. `uses: actions/checkout@<40-hex-sha>`.

findings.title: Container runs as root (no USER directive)
findings.remediation: Add a USER instruction near the end of the Dockerfile to specify a non-root user, e.g. `USER 1001` or `USER appuser`.
